# StillDeadcode/vllm-radiance

**The Radiance vLLM image for gfx1201 — the base most community R9700 forks build on.**

**Use it if:** You have an RDNA4 card (R9700-class) and want the common vLLM base the rest of the R9700 ecosystem assumes.
